text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, shouting suddenly echoed from a 
classroom I was passing by—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: I told you, I have nothing to say to you!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
What's that supposed to mean?! You 
stubborn blockhead!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Entering the room, I found Furioso and her 
classmate ready to jump at each other's 
throats.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Seriously, what's your problem...?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Whoa there, what's the situation here?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: What is it, Tran? Stay out of this!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Sure, sure, I'll scram, but mind filling 
me in on what happened first?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Well... I just tried to strike up a 
conversation with Furioso.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
It was just a casual joke about life in 
the countryside, but she got super mad...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I see. Sounds like Furi, alright.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
—So that's what I heard, but is that 
accurate?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...That is correct. I lost my temper at 
her remarks and raised my voice.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Saying the countryside is inconvenient and 
looking down on it... It felt like an 
insult...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Mhm, I getcha, I getcha.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I've got the gist of the 
situation. Now then, what should we do 
about this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Transcend brought 
Furioso along to the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Really now, I am quite busy. I don't have 
time to leisurely dine...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Come on, it's a special tasting event for 
the new menu. It'd be a waste not to enjoy 
it!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Kh...! Tran-san, don't tell me...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. We just came to have some food, 
didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that everyone's here, let's 
dig in~!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
T-This dish... could it be made with 
ingredients from Funabashi...?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
And this seafood... it's a specialty from 
my hometown...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Huh, really? What an amazing coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Are you sure you can give us this 
much?! As expected of Furi's hometown, so 
generous~♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~! So fresh and lively~! If we cook a 
meal with this, that girl is gonna love it 
for sure!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Transcend had visited both of their 
hometowns, contacted local vendors, and 
gathered their favorite specialty 
ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had arranged for the dishes to be 
prepared, organizing a reconciliation meal 
under the guise of a food tasting.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright you two, there's plenty on the 
menu, so eat up before it gets cold!

text_block_list.name: Furioso and others
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...This fish has great texture and flavor. 
Local produce truly hits differently.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Right? But these vegetables from Funabashi 
are delicious too. You can really taste 
the growers' dedication—I could eat these 
endlessly.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Precisely. Funabashi is the best. Not just 
its specialty produce, but the warmth of 
the people living there as well.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Man, you really love your hometown, don't 
you? ...I get why you'd be mad hearing 
what I said. I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...No. You had no ill intent. I was... a 
bit childish myself.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Fighting with someone who loves their 
hometown just as much... I am truly sorry 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, tell me more about Funabashi 
sometime. Like good food spots and fun 
places to hang out.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Of course. And please, tell me all about 
your hometown as well.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, looks like those two will be just 
fine now.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Started with hometown pride, resolved with 
hometown pride. A clean and tidy 
conclusion, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, well, I did rope you into carrying 
the luggage, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'd say the results were well worth 
the heavy lifting.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, nothing beats the satisfaction 
of a job well done for an info broker.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
True that! Watching them eat with such 
gusto made my own stomach start growling.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
With gratitude to all the local folks who 
helped out, let's dig in~♪
